posts.title: The 7-second paw test
posts.summary: Before a walk, press the back of your hand on the pavement for 7 seconds. If it's too hot for your hand, it's too hot for paws. In a Bakersfield summer, walk early in the morning or after sunset.

posts.title: Teach a rock-solid "leave it"
posts.summary: Hold a treat in a closed fist. Wait until your dog stops sniffing and backs off, then say "yes" and reward from your other hand. Practice a few minutes a day before adding the words "leave it."
